entities.summary: Army, created in 1422, that would be mustered from the constituents of the holy roman empire, during an imperial military campaign (reichsheerfahrt) during an imperial war (reichskrieg) or an imperial execution (reichsexekution) Located in Holy Roman Empire. Founded 1422. Dissolved 1806.
